description: Canalisations - CAPV - OpenDATA is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté d'Agglomération Plaine Vallée. This layer geolocates the sewerage networks managed by the agglomeration community: wastewater, rainwater, unitary. Community collection networks are interconnected with the trade union sanitation networks (SIAH and SIARE unrepresented) whose function is transport. This layer makes it possible to indicate the supposed or not presence of sewerage networks (approximate location) and the type of pipe. Coverage: Communauté d'Agglomération Plaine Vallée. The portal shows the English title as "Pipelines - CAPV - OpenDATA" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Communauté d'Agglomération Plaine Vallée. Its keywords include geospatial, capv, reseaux, assainissement, canalisation. The listing shows 6 download or service links in KML, ZIP, GEOJSON, WEB PAGE. The listing shows 2025-02-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
